CA.name: American angelica
CA.citation: Wikipedia; native range confirmed across eastern North America including Ontario. Also documented as purplestem angelica, great angelica, masterwort. Deliberately distinguished from Angelica archangelica (garden/European angelica), a taxonomically and geographically distinct European species

US.name: American angelica
US.citation: Gardenia.net; Mrs. Grieve's A Modern Herbal (1931), which explicitly documents the historical use of this species as a substitute for the European Angelica archangelica while treating them as clearly distinct plants
